title: Industrial Designs (Electronic Filing) Administrative Instructions, No. 8 of 2006
text:
Industrial Designs 1
BELIZE:
ADMINISTRATIVE INSTRUCTIONS
No. 8 of 2006
______
ADMINISTRATIVE INSTRUCTIONS made by the Registrar of Intellectual
Property in exercise of the powers conferred upon him by section 69 of the
Patents Act, Chapter 253 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition
2000.
Short title. 1. These Administrative Instructions may be cited as the
INDUSTRIAL DESIGNS (ELECTRONIC FILING) ADMINISTRATIVE
INSTRUCTIONS, 2006.
Electronic filing 2.(1) In submitting an industrial design application to the Office, an applicant
and signature.
may use an electronic application form if the information is accessible so as to be
usable for subsequent reference.
(2) An applicant may use an electronic signature to sign the electronic
application form.
(3) In this paragraph, the expression “electronic signature” includes –
(a) any combination of letters, numbers, spaces or punctuation marks
placed between two forward slash (“/”) symbols. Examples of
acceptable signatures for electronic application forms include
/ramses/, /drl/, and /577-34567/; or
(b) a signature handwritten on Form No. 13 outlined in the Schedule to
these Administrative Instructions.

Industrial Designs 2
(4) An applicant must notify the Office of his particular method of electronic
signature.
MADE by the Registrar of Intellectual Property this 19th day of May, 2006.
(ALHAJI TEJAN-COLE)
Deputy Registrar of Intellectual Property
